note: Known-answer vectors for the group promotion token (docs/GROUP_CALLS_V2.md section 2.7; the byte format is the layout in that section; it moves to a WIRE_SPEC section, number to be assigned, when the four mirrors take it). Generated by tools/katgen/grouptoken with the Go standard library only (crypto/ed25519 is deterministic RFC 8032). The keys are test keys, the ids are test ids. Clients pin the SHA-256 of this file.

constants.DATA: <1:1 call id as its transcript spells it> | GRPPROMO: base64(TOKEN), standard alphabet, padded, canonical
constants.TBS_LAYOUT: PROMO_DOMAIN || u8(version) || LP(groupCallId) || LP(fromCallId) || acceptBinding1[32] || LP(creatorUserId) || signerIK[32] || u8(callType) || u64be(issuedAtMs) || u32be(lifetimeMs) || u8(n) || LP(invitee_1) .. LP(invitee_n); LP(x) = u16be(len) || x

fixed_inputs.verifier_state: live L, peerUserId = C, self = P, anchor defined with signerKey = the creator public key and acceptBinding1 as above, kcmacVerified = true, now = issuedAtMs + 1000

encode.name: v1-two-invitees
encode.note: Invitees are written out of order on purpose: the builder sorts them.

encode.name: v2-case-folding
encode.note: G, L, C and X in upper case (the peer P is lower case): the TBS is identical to v1; only the wire prefix of data carries L as the transcript spells it.

encode.name: v3-max-invitees
encode.note: P plus the 62 ids %08x-0000-4000-8000-%012x for i = 1..62: 63 invitees, the maximum.

encode.name: v4-peer-only
encode.note: The 1:1 peer is the only invitee.

verify.name: live_call_id_upper_case_in_state

verify.name: b64_with_a_trailing_equals

replay.name: same_token_delivered_twice
replay.note: A byte-identical copy (a re-send) changes nothing and is not logged.

replay.name: different_token_for_the_same_group_id
replay.note: The second token (issuedAtMs + 1000, signed) is dropped; the first stays.

replay.name: five_tokens_for_five_group_ids
replay.note: The fifth store evicts the first by receipt; its group id stays in usedGroupIds, so a late copy of it is dup_group.

predicate.name: base_auto_join
predicate.note: Token stored, anchor defined, KCMAC verified.

predicate.name: promoted_string_true
predicate.note: A string is not the JSON literal true.

predicate.name: no_token
predicate.note: Held for 3000 ms without a ring, then it rings.

predicate.name: kcmac_not_verified
predicate.note: A token is stored; the round-1 KCMAC is still pending.

predicate.name: token_consumed
predicate.note: A consumed token never admits a second join.

predicate.name: another_group_live
predicate.note: Today's busy rule may drop the invite instead of ringing it; that is unchanged.

predicate.name: call_type_video_in_the_invite
predicate.note: The invite's call_type plays no part: the join is audio-only with the camera off (join_audio_only).

predicate.name: ring_up_token_arrives
predicate.note: A ring is taken down locally with no group_call_decline, then the device joins.

predicate.name: ring_up_user_accepted
predicate.note: Once the user has accepted, nothing is converted.

predicate.name: ring_up_user_declined
predicate.note: Once the user has declined, nothing is converted.

predicate.name: push_rang_first_then_ws_invite
predicate.note: The push invite carries no promoted, so it is never a candidate and rings; the WebSocket invite then converts that ring.
